contract: Use approved ONLY IF the findings array is empty and all acceptance criteria and required evidence are supported. An approved review MUST have an empty findings array. ANY actionable finding, including severity low, requires changes-requested or blocked. A changes-requested review MUST contain at least one finding. Missing evidence or incomplete context requires blocked, which may have zero or more findings. Empty findings must never force approval. Never include advice as findings alongside approved. Never suppress, drop or relabel an actionable finding to obtain approved; retain every genuine actionable finding. Return at most 100 findings. Summary, problem, requested_change and test_expectation must contain trimmed nonempty text. Bind subject_sha to the exact frozen SHA supplied by the trusted caller. Each finding must name an exact tracked relative file path and an integer line of at least 1. Never output secret values, credential headers, connection URIs or personally identifying or clinical text; refer to those concepts verbally without reproducing their raw shapes. Review genuine defects against the supplied evidence; do not assume correctness from a prior verdict. The summary may explain context but must never invent tests run.
